messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: P1 network alert - asia-east1 zone-b observed repeated peering flaps causing external egress failures for a subset of customer traffic. Pager -> @Maria C, @Ajay K. Alert ID: INC-2026-0321.
Maria C: I'm on it. Seeing spike in TCP retransmits and connection resets to our edge egress host in asia-east1-b. Error rate ~18% for outgoing requests to customer endpoints.
Ajay K: I'm joining, pulling BGP/session stats now. Not seeing CPU or mem issues on the nodes. Could be peering/ISP side.
Maria C: Confirmed: peer ASN sessions exhibiting frequent flaps starting 1795001200. BGP session resets correlate with customer 5xx. Runbook: network/peering-flap -> step 2.
Ajay K: Starting mitigation - shifting affected egress routes off the impacted peering to alternate transit via asia-south1 and us-east1 edge proxies. Applying traffic policy change now (no downtime expected but some sessions will reconnect).
Lee W: Tagging support so we can surface to impacted customers quickly. Support ticket template ready if you want to reuse.
Riley (Support Lead): Please prepare a short, clear customer-facing note: region impacted, mitigation in progress, expected next update in 30m. Avoid technical jargon.
Maria C: Drafting status page update and customer note here. Also creating an internal postmortem channel after resolution.
statuspage-bot: DRAFT STATUSPAGE UPDATE queued for review. Current component states: asia-east1 edge egress (partial outage), asia-south1 edge egress (operational), us-east1 edge egress (operational).
Maria C: Statuspage draft: 

---
We are currently investigating increased outbound request failures for customers routing through asia-east1 (zone-b). Impact: some external calls may fail or experience timeouts. Mitigation: traffic is being shifted to alternative edge regions (asia-south1/us-east1) while we work with the transit provider to stabilize peering sessions.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have new info.
---

Please review and tell me if ok to post.
Ajay K: LGTM. Also adding tech note for internal: BGP flap root cause suspected; we opened a ticket with upstream ISP (ref U-ISP-789). Will capture tcpdump of resets and BGP session logs in /var/log/net/peers/17950012*.
Lee W: Customer notification (support-friendly): 

Hi <customer>,
We're seeing intermittent failures for requests routed via our asia-east1 edge region. Our engineers are shifting traffic to alternate regions and are working with our network partner to resolve. We do not expect a prolonged outage and will update you within 30 minutes.
Apologies for the disruption — please reply here if you need more frequent updates.

Riley (Support Lead): Good. Put that on PROD support channel and mark impacted customers based on recent hits to asia-east1. I'll coordinate one-off outreach for enterprise accounts.
oncall-bot: Note: Incident severity set to P1. Paging rules: primary oncall (Maria C) -> secondary (Ajay K) -> escalation to EngSRE lead.
Maria C: Mitigation applied: policy pushed to route new egress sessions via asia-south1/us-east1 proxies. Early telemetry shows error rate dropping from 18% -> 4% for affected tenants. Ongoing intermittent failures are limited to existing long-lived connections; instructing ops to terminate stale connections where safe.
Ajay K: Confirmed route-change command used: 
```
rbx route apply --scope=egress --from=asia-east1-b --to=asia-south1,us-east1 --mode=gradual --drain=true
```
Maria C: Will keep channel updated. Opening a ticket with upstream: U-ISP-789, contact on-call at ISP endpoint has acknowledged.
statuspage-bot: UPDATE POSTED to status page: "Partial outage in asia-east1 affecting outbound connections. Traffic being routed to alternate regions. Investigation underway."
Lee W: Internal comms snippet for slack/all: 

Heads up: We're investigating partial outbound egress failures in asia-east1 (zone-b). Mitigation: traffic shifted to alternate regions; customer impact reduced. EngSRE leading the fix; support is handling customer notifications.

Please avoid escalating unless you see new issues.

Maria C: On-call handoff: I'm handing to SRE Rotation for monitoring through the night. Key notes for next shift: 1) monitor BGP session flaps and peer health 2) confirm upstream ticket progress (U-ISP-789) 3) validate no regressions after draining 4) follow customer outreach list (linked in ticket).
SRE Rotation: Taking over. Thanks @Maria C. I'll watch the health dashboard and keep statuspage updated. Please drop the connection logs link and any active mitigation commands.
Maria C: Links: tcpdumps & bgp logs -> s3://redwood-incident-logs/1795001234/, mitigation commands in incident-runbook doc (link). Also created child incident for follow-up RCA: INC-2026-0321-RCA.
Ajay K: Quick checklist for rotation: 
- Verify BGP session stability (expect no flaps for 30m)
- Confirm error rates stay <5% for affected customers
- Keep status page cadence: 30m
- If regressions >10%, consider reconfiguring transit or temporarily enabling extra proxy capacity in asia-south1

Maria C: Thanks team. Posting customer note now and closing the urgent page. Will re-open if ISP reports new flap.
statuspage-bot: CUSTOMER UPDATE SENT to subscribed customers for affected component(s).
Riley (Support Lead): Support update: triage list posted, enterprise outreach started. Will update next 30m.
SRE Rotation: Acknowledged takeover at 1795003600. Monitoring continuing.
Maria C: Last update before handoff: traffic routing successful, major error rates reduced. Leaving ops ticket for connection drains.
SRE Rotation: Copy. I'll post a follow-up in 30m or earlier if anything changes.
